case_classification.short_description: Easy and regular yearly debt waterfall modeling

ai_time_estimate_reasoning: This is a highly complex debt waterfall and equity modeling task. It requires modeling pro-rata repayment allocations with roll-forwards for multiple senior debt tranches, convertible debt with interest-to-equity conversion features, and a detailed vintage-based vesting tracker for new share classes to calculate dividend eligibility over a 20-year period. Since interest is calculated on opening balances, circular references are avoided, but the vintage tracking for conversion shares (requiring the later of standard vesting or conversion date plus 3/4 years) and the sequential distribution waterfall still require meticulous structuring and validation to answer the 30 specific output questions accurately.
